description: This file contains unit tests for the 'RoundRobinSelector' class, which implements a resource selection strategy with round-robin logic. The tests verify correct distribution, non-infinite traversal, and duplicate handling when selecting resources.

classes.name: RoundRobinSelectorTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of the RoundRobinSelector resource selection strategy.

methods.name: NextSelectionWillGoThroughEveryResourceIfExistingSelectionEmptyTest
methods.description: Tests that the round-robin selector goes through every resource when the initial selection is empty.

methods.name: NextSelectionWontGoInfinitelyTest
methods.description: Ensures that the selector does not enter an infinite loop during selection.

methods.name: NextSelectionWontReSelectExistingSelectionsTest
methods.description: Verifies that the selector does not re-select resources already selected.

methods.name: NextSelectionWontReSelectExistingSelectionsWithDuplicatesTest
methods.description: Checks that the selector handles duplicate resources correctly without re-selecting them.
